LanguageData.Gun_Fort-500FS_RWP.description: The Fort-500FS is a high-caliber firearm designed for unrivaled stopping power. Favored by mercenaries and hunters alike, this weapon combines accuracy with a rugged design, ensuring reliability in the harshest conditions. Its semi-automatic action allows for quick follow-up shots, perfect for incapacitating large targets swiftly. Ideal for those situations where every shot must count.
